_comment: Copy this file to customer-config.json and fill in all values before running cdk synth.
_email_from_note: Required. SES from-address for team invite email — the primary way users join after the first admin.
_email_identity_type_note: Required. email = verify via inbox link. domain = verify domain; add email_hosted_zone_id if the public hosted zone is in this AWS account for automatic DKIM records; omit zone id to export DkimRecord* outputs for manual DNS elsewhere.
_email_hosted_zone_id_note: Required for domain + Route53 (pattern A). Omit when DNS is outside this account (pattern B). Find with: aws route53 list-hosted-zones.
_account_region_note: Account and region are NOT in this file. Templates are env-agnostic (AWS::AccountId / AWS::Region). Choose the target account/region at deploy time (AWS profile / CLI region).
_handlers_network_note: When compute_type is ec2, stack-b exposes HandlersNetworkMode / ExistingVpcId / ExistingSubnetIds (CommaDelimitedList) as CloudFormation parameters at deploy time — not in this file. Prefer the CFN console or quoted --parameter-overrides; see launcher/README.md Handlers network.
_platform_defaults_note: architecture, backend seed image URI/tag, etc. → launcher/cdk/platform_defaults.json
_github_handlers_repo_note: If github_repo == github_handlers_repo delete github_handlers_repo from this file
_github_oidc_sub_prefix_note: Optional. GitHub repo Settings → Actions → OIDC → Default subject claim prefix (immutable OWNER@ID/REPO@ID). Paste with or without the leading repo:. Omit to trust the name-only sub (older repos). Do not put this in github_repo — that field stays OWNER/REPO for SSM. The same prefix is used for both staging and production roles (:environment:{stage} is appended). github_handlers_oidc_sub_prefix is only needed when github_handlers_repo is a different repo; otherwise it inherits github_oidc_sub_prefix.
_package_registry_note: Optional. Lets the GitHub deploy role pip/npm install from CodeArtifact. Omit domain_owner when the publisher domain is in this tenant account. Set domain_owner to the publisher AWS account for cross-account pull (that account must also list this tenant in reader_aws_accounts).
